tagline: Upload a PDF, name the fields you want, and get typed values back — from the web app or a pay-per-extraction API.
summary: Extract Text pulls structured data out of PDFs. You upload a document and list the fields you expect (or pick a saved **PDF type**); Claude reads the pages and returns typed values you can review, accept or deny field by field. Once an extraction looks right you can save its fields as a PDF type and reuse it for the next document of the same kind.

It's a credit-based product: one credit pays for one successful extraction, failed extractions refund it, and packs are sold through Stripe Checkout. Developers can create `etp_live_` API keys and call `POST /api/v1/extract` directly. The browser signs in with Supabase; Express verifies the JWT, stores the PDF and calls a private Python service that does the actual parsing.
audience: You process recurring PDFs (invoices, forms, statements) and want the same fields out of each one.
You're a developer who needs a simple PDF → JSON API with predictable per-document pricing.
You operate the product and need to run the three services and the Supabase project behind it.
notFor: OCR of scanned images at scale or handwriting — it reads PDF pages (PyMuPDF) and asks Claude.
Bulk batch pipelines — one PDF per request.
A local-only tool — it depends on Supabase auth/storage and Stripe.

capabilities.title: Workspace upload
capabilities.detail: `/workspace` uploads a PDF with expected fields or a PDF type and runs the extraction.

capabilities.title: Review results
capabilities.detail: `/extractions` lists runs; `/extraction-detail-page` shows each field to accept, deny, edit or retry.

capabilities.title: PDF types
capabilities.detail: `/pdf-types` saves a field set from a good extraction and reapplies it (`POST /api/pdf-types/assign`).

capabilities.title: Credits and checkout
capabilities.detail: Credit balance in the sidebar; Stripe one-time pack (`extract-credits-20`: 20 credits for $3) with `/checkout-return`; webhooks grant credits only when Stripe reports paid.

capabilities.title: Developer API
capabilities.detail: `/developer` creates and revokes `etp_live_` keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes); `POST /api/v1/extract` runs the same pipeline.

capabilities.title: AI ledger
capabilities.detail: Each parse writes `extraction_requests`, `extraction_exchanges` (tokens, cost, read mode) and `extraction_responses`.

capabilities.title: Sign-in
capabilities.detail: Email or Google via Supabase; `/auth/callback` and a waitlist endpoint.

components.name: Web app
components.stack: Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Supabase JS, Vercel Analytics
components.owns: Landing, auth, workspace, extractions, PDF types, developer page, docs. Calls Express at `NEXT_PUBLIC_EXPRESS_URL` with the Supabase JWT.
components.doesNotOwn: PDF storage paths, the Python URL/token, Stripe secrets.

components.name: API gateway
components.owns: JWT/API-key auth, PDF upload to Supabase Storage, credits (consume/refund), Stripe checkout + webhook, PDF types, field reviews, the AI ledger, `supabase/migrations/`.
components.doesNotOwn: Reading the PDF — it delegates to Python.

components.name: Extraction service
components.runsOn: Private host reachable only from Express
components.owns: Reading PDF pages and the Claude prompt/response that returns field values. Requires `PYTHON_INTERNAL_TOKEN`.

dataFlow: The user signs in with Supabase in the browser; the web app sends the JWT to Express (or an `etp_live_` key for the API).
Express consumes one credit (402 if the balance is zero), uploads the PDF to Supabase Storage and creates an `extractions` row.
Express calls the Python service at `PYTHON_SERVER_URL` with `PYTHON_INTERNAL_TOKEN`; Python reads pages with PyMuPDF and asks Claude for the fields.
Express stores the fields and the request/exchange/response ledger; on failure it refunds the credit.
Buying credits: Express creates a Stripe Checkout Session, the webhook (`STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) marks the pack paid and adds credits.

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: Supabase anon key and its own JWT only. Never sees storage paths, the Python URL or token.

trust.title: Express
trust.detail: Supabase service role key, Stripe secret and webhook secret, Python internal token. Verifies every JWT with `auth.getUser`.

trust.title: Python service
trust.detail: Anthropic key; trusts only requests with the internal token. Should not be publicly reachable.

trust.title: Supabase / Stripe / Anthropic
trust.detail: Users, PDFs and balances in Supabase; card data stays on Stripe; PDF contents go to Anthropic.

commonTasks.title: Run the stack locally
steps: Run **Setup** in Hub for web and API; clone `extract-text-from-pdf-python-server` next to them yourself.
Apply `supabase/migrations/001…008` to your Supabase project and create the PDF storage bucket.
Set `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `PYTHON_SERVER_URL`, `PYTHON_INTERNAL_TOKEN`, `WEB_ORIGIN` (and Stripe vars if testing checkout) on the API.
Start Python (`python main.py`) with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and the same `PYTHON_INTERNAL_TOKEN`.
Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_EXPRESS_URL=http://localhost:3064` and the Supabase public vars on the web, then **Run**.

commonTasks.title: Extract a new kind of document
commonTasks.when: First PDF of a new layout.
steps: In `/workspace`, upload the PDF and list the fields you expect.
Review the result; deny wrong fields and retry if needed.
Save it as a PDF type so the next upload only needs the type.

commonTasks.title: Call the API
steps: `POST /api/v1/extract` with `Authorization: Bearer etp_live_…`, the PDF, and either `pdfTypeId` or inline `fields`.
Watch for 402 (out of credits) and 401 (bad key).

commonTasks.title: Test credit purchases
steps: Forward webhooks with `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3064/...` and buy a pack from the app.
Credits appear after the webhook, not on the success redirect.

troubleshooting.fix: No credits left. Buy a pack, or add balance in `extract_balance` for testing.
No Supabase session reached Express, or the API key isn't an active `etp_live_` key.

troubleshooting.symptom: Extractions fail with a server error
troubleshooting.fix: Python service down or token mismatch. Check `PYTHON_SERVER_URL`, matching `PYTHON_INTERNAL_TOKEN`, and the Python `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. The credit is refunded.
The Stripe webhook didn't arrive or `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is wrong.
`NEXT_PUBLIC_EXPRESS_URL` must point at port 3064 (older builds used 3009); add the web origin to `WEB_ORIGIN`.

glossary.definition: A saved set of expected fields reused for documents with the same layout.
One successful extraction; refunded on failure.
How the PDF was read for Claude (recorded on the exchange).

hubNotes: `extract-text-from-pdf-python-server` isn't in the registry, so Hub can't run it — extractions fail unless you start it yourself. Consider registering it as a third repo.
Neither the web nor the API repo has a `.env.example`; use the env vars listed here (taken from the code).
No local Postgres — data, auth and files live in Supabase (`supabase/migrations/`).
Repo READMEs are still the templates; the ADRs (web 013–017, express 009–012) are the real docs.
